evals.name: register-author
evals.prompt: Specify that registering Aster writes to the requested author.
evals.expected_output: Use a fixed input and assert the event address and name.
assertions: Defines Aster as a RegisterAuthor example with a fixed ID.
Checks AuthorRegistered for that ID with name Aster.

evals.name: blank-author
evals.prompt: Add a rejection case without duplicating the registration inputs.
evals.expected_output: Override only the name and assert its configured error.
assertions: Overrides name to an empty string.
Expects the validation error rather than then no events.

evals.name: run-both
evals.prompt: How do we check the registration and refusal specifications we just added?
evals.expected_output: Run both executable model examples and examine their results.
assertions: Runs screenplay test on the composed model folder.
Checks both examples executed and passed.
Does not claim a live application append from the model test.
